notes.title: The Deepwatch - Update 19.03.2025
notes.content:
[h1]Version - XXXX[/h1]

[b]Developer's note:[/b] This patch is aimed at enhancing the gaming experience and addressing several issues encountered by players.
[h2]PC[/h2]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed the functionality of elements on the "desk."

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
- Visual design of the "Dialog" element has been updated;
- The display of information about committed violations has been modified;
- Training has been improved, and an "Instructions" section has been added.

notes.title: The Deepwatch - UPD 28.01.2025
notes.content:
[h1]Version - 17155599[/h1]
[b]Developer's Note:[/b] This patch aims to improve the gaming experience and address a number of issues that players have encountered.
[h2]PC[/h2]
[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Document Errors:
- Fixed errors in document text.
- Fixed errors in document photos.
- Fixed errors in the data of the arrivals.
[*] Document Display:
- Fixed document display to ensure they are correctly shown on the screen.
[*] Tutorial Step:
- Fixed the tutorial step that was misleading players.
[/olist]
[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Terminal Window Focus:
- Added the ability to focus the terminal window for convenience.
[*] Day Transition:
- Added animations for day transitions to enhance the gaming experience.
[/olist]

notes.title: The Deepwatch - Hot Fix 17.01.2025
notes.content:
[h1][i]Version - 17038360[/i][/h1]

[i]Developer's Note:[/i] This hotfix patch addresses critical game errors. Users might have encountered these issues during the tutorial phase or while using the "scanner" game elements, which were caused by incorrectly generated game configurations.

[h2]PC[/h2]

[list]
[*] [h3]Stability[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed instances that could lead to game freezes and/or blocking of interactive elements during the tutorial.
[/list]
[*] [h3]Sound[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed sound accompaniments.
[/list]
[*] [h3] Knowledge[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a window error that prevented continuing the game process when attempting to exit "Settings".
[*] Fixed an error with the "Scanner" game elements, where the element would freeze and could not be reused when the charge was low.
[*] Fixed an error where task results were incorrectly displayed in the "Daily Summary" window.
[/list]
[/list]
